name: UGC 64 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 64, a nearby galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc64-hubble
story: One of the last nearby galaxies Hubble set out to visit in its effort to image every known galaxy near the Milky Way, resolving its brightest stars.

claims.text: UGC-00064 (alternate name PGC591) is a target of Hubble program 15922, Every Known Nearby Galaxy
The program targets the remaining suspected nearby galaxies not yet observed by Hubble
